Quantified tolerance sensitivity — nominal prototype

This is a deterministic screening calculation, not a tolerance-qualified assembly or fit release. Unknown process errors remain unknown. No statistical/RSS stack or oil-flow prediction is used.

Generated by checks/tolerance_analysis.py; exact input hashes are in review/tolerance-analysis.json. The retained supplier feed was generated 2026-04-29T20:52:33.873247+00:00. It states inch dimensions; values here are converted with 25.4 mm/in. SST-048: nominal 1.2192 mm, thickness +0.0762/-0.0762 mm; cut +0.127/-0.127 mm. SST-030: nominal 0.762 mm, thickness +0.0508/-0.0508 mm; cut +0.127/-0.127 mm. These are supplier records, not post-weld, reamed-hole or heading allowances. Raw flatness guidance is retained in JSON; it is not converted into a guaranteed welded-assembly flatness.

Moving/fixed cheek gaps

g = g0 + delta(fixed centre - moving centre) - (delta_tf + delta_tm)/2 in each side’s outward coordinate. Positive signed centre separation opens that side; evaluate both sides independently. The stock-only case holds centre planes fixed, which a face-locating jig may not do.

Nominal each-side gap: 0.300000 mm. Stock thickness alone gives 0.223800–0.376200 mm. At both positive stock limits, a further 0.223800 mm of relative closure reaches geometric contact. Positive clearance alone does not qualify free motion.

Bore, pin and alignment

cD = B - P; cR = (B - P)/2. Nominal values are 0.425000 mm diametral and 0.212500 mm radial. For a specified candidate common straight pin axis, each bore’s radial axis offset must be less than its local radial clearance. This is a necessary geometric screening condition, not a complete four-bore assembly, angular-alignment or friction proof.

Continuous roof gap and local sensitivities

z(theta)=Pz+(y-Py)sin(theta)+(z-Pz)cos(theta); exact extrema are tested at both endpoints and atan2(y-Py,z-Pz) when inside travel. All outer cheek/leaf vertices are considered. Circular bores remove material. This independently matches the saved continuous whole-plane roof calculation.

Controlling absolute point: [14.0, 40.392304845413264] mm; angle 43.897886248 degrees; roof gap 1.577794898 mm. The whole underside plane is a conservative roof, not actual OEM-cover geometry.

Rigid translation moves the pivot and all door vertices together. Changing only the pivot while freezing absolute vertices changes their vectors relative to the axis; its vertical sensitivity is cos(theta)-1, not -1. Do not add rigid and relative terms for the same physical error. These are local frozen-contour sensitivities, not permission to resize the calibrated model. The controlling angle lies inside travel; changing the stop limit alone does not change this maximum while it still includes that angle and the contour is unchanged.

g >= g0 - frame_down - rigid_door_up - max[U sin(theta)+V cos(theta)] - extra_upward_envelope. U,V are independently bounded errors of a point relative to its pivot, not absolute position errors. The projection maximum is evaluated over 0–60 degrees; this bound can be conservative across vertices. Weld bead, distortion, thermal change and deflection need actual justified bounds.

Geometric contact occurs after 1.577794898 mm of a single rigid vertical closure, or equal frame-down/door-up shifts of 0.788897449 mm each. Equal independent relative-point coordinate bounds of 1.115669472 mm exhaust this conservative projection budget. These zero-gap limits are not usable operating margins.

Mounting stack and bolt reach

I=L_underhead-S_clamp measures tip insertion from the boss seat. delta_I=delta_L-delta_S; tip-bottoming clearance is H_hole-I. With the same bolt and unchanged original stack, added sheet thickness reduces insertion by that thickness. Actual insertion remains UNKNOWN because bolt, seats and boss are unmeasured.

11.2192001.143000–1.295400

Mount blanks are unpositioned; these are not actual installed stacks. Insertion loss is not automatically engaged-thread loss. For compatible full-thread intervals [x0,x1] measured from the bolt underside and [a,b] in the boss from its seat, E=max(0,min(x1,S+b)-max(x0,S+a)). Exclude tip, runout, damaged and incomplete threads. Partial/self-tapping threads also require identification and installation-process evidence; this interval equation does not predict thread forming or strength. Required engagement, bottoming margin, preload/torque, boss material and retention remain UNKNOWN.

Floor aperture screen and release holds

Using the nominal inner perimeter 550.246400 mm, a uniform gap of 1.046804 mm has the same simple aperture area as one 36 × 16 mm window. This ignores casting contours, flow length, oil level and pressure; equal area does not mean equal flow or retained volume.

Fabrication release remains held for measured fixture/weld/finished-hole/head variations, actual pin and bore-axis data, registered pan/cover/pickup/mount geometry and a complete stack. Engine-use release additionally requires physical motion, retention, material/load/thermal and performance evidence. No scenario table closes these holds.
